responsibility: Implements resolve-time checking and lint preparation for unused and redundant imports. It walks resolved `use` and `extern crate` items using resolver usage data, computes removable spans for diagnostics and rustfix, defers trait-import cases that need method resolution, finalizes privacy-related import state, and buffers lints for unused imports, redundant imports, unused `extern crate`s, `macro_use`, and unnecessary qualifications.
